status: First pass, 19 November 2026: the air battle check's flares (roadmap B13, -SimAirShots).
notes: Game values for the air battle check (data/scenarios/air_battle_flares.json, -SimAirShots' second scenario), not the air war: one NATO flight at a time from 12-14 km out over the battery, where the scenario's Strela-2 team shoots at it on the pass (test_waves.hpp WavePassKillChance) and its pilots, seeing the launch, fire flares by their reactions (gameplay/reactions.json, countermeasures by type and year). The rest as gameplay/test_waves.json, whose loader reads this file (simcore/air_war/test_waves_data.hpp).

timing.notes: One flight a wave, the first 5 s in, the next every 20-30 s while fewer than twelve aircraft are up; none of ours. Leavers are gone 30 s after the pass.

geometry.notes: From the battery: in from 12-14 km, the aims within 1.5 km of it, so each flight passes over the Strela-2 team.
